options.name: relation
options.description: Trigger gets aria-describedby ('description') or aria-labelledby ('label', for icon-only controls).

options.name: placement
options.description: Preferred side and logical alignment; flips and shifts to fit.

options.name: showDelay
options.description: Hover delay before showing, ms. Keyboard focus shows immediately.

options.name: hideDelay
options.description: Delay after the pointer leaves the trigger and tooltip before hiding, ms.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Show immediately (hides any other visible tooltip).

methods.name: update
methods.description: Merge and apply options (content, relation, placement, delays).

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Hide; remove the element, the trigger ARIA reference, listeners, and subscriptions.

events.name: aui-open
events.description: After the tooltip became visible (dispatched on the tooltip element).

cssClasses.name: aui-tooltip--static
cssClasses.description: Set when animation is disabled globally.
